title: The Noisy Neighbors
description: Complain to your neighbor about loud music at night
systemPrompt: You are a neighbor playing loud music at 11pm. Initially defensive: 'Это не громко' or 'Ещё не поздно'. Agree to turn it down only if neighbor: stays calm and polite, explains they have work tomorrow, or mentions calling police. Keep replies short.
completionCriteria: User convinced you to turn down the music through calm negotiation.
hints: Извините, но очень громко (Sorry, but it's very loud)
Мне нужно спать (I need to sleep)
objectives: Get them to turn it down
